items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: And that’s sort of the kind of thing that Bird and Monk and Miles and Dizzy, they did also.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know a friend of mine, we were just talking about that the other day. One of the things that Herbie Hancock and Wayne Shorter and Ron Carter, since when you’re talking about Herbie and Wayne and Ron, you know you don’t have to use their last names, everybody knows who you’re talking about. One of the things that perpetrated their music was the fact that they played each other’s music. And that’s sort of the kind of thing that Bird and Monk and Miles and Dizzy, they did also. They played each other’s…
I think it helps too if there’s a lyric.
